title: Requesting an internal department move
instructions: Write in English in connected paragraphs. Complete all the requested points. Task 1 requires at least 150 words. Complete the separate Task 2 essay with at least 250 words.

stimulus.text:
Task 1
You began your present job two years ago. You now believe that moving to another department in the same organisation would help your career development. Requests go to a manager responsible for internal moves, whom you have not met. Write a letter to that manager. In your letter:
• explain what you have learned in your current role
• explain how the organisation could benefit from your move to a different department
• give your reasons for wanting to remain with the organisation.
Begin your letter: Dear Sir or Madam,
Write at least 150 words in connected paragraphs. You do not need to write any addresses. Aim to spend about 20 minutes. Use a formal style.

Task 2
At some well-known visitor attractions, people concentrate on taking photographs of themselves instead of looking closely at the place. Why might this happen? Do you consider this a positive or a negative development?
Give reasons for your answers and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words in connected paragraphs. Aim to spend about 40 minutes.

questions.prompt: Write your letter. Develop every part of all three bullet points and write at least 150 words.
Write a separate essay answering both questions in Task 2. Write at least 250 words.

teachingAnchors.label: Build the language first
teachingAnchors.text: Separate experience already gained from a proposed future contribution. “I have learned to ... over two years” describes accumulated experience; “I could use this to ...” proposes a contribution, not a guaranteed outcome. Choose one real skill and show how it transfers to another department. Connect a reason to its consequence without promising an unsupported result.

teachingAnchors.label: Plan for the recipient
teachingAnchors.text: Make a three-part plan: what you have learned, what the organisation gains from the internal move, and why you want to stay. Each part needs a developed answer; enthusiasm alone does not explain the organisational benefit. Use a respectful formal request and keep the career move distinct from resignation. For the essay, plan the cause question and the evaluation question separately.

teachingAnchors.label: Draft, then check coverage
teachingAnchors.text: Write the complete letter in connected paragraphs. Check every component of each bullet against an actual sentence; a vague mention is not full development. Read time phrases and references aloud to test clarity. Revise one underdeveloped reason and one inaccurate sentence, then explain the changes. For the separate essay, make a two-column plan, one for each question. A cause is not an evaluation: answer both with explanation and a relevant example.

criteria.label: Task achievement — Task 1
criteria.description: For Task 1 only: clear letter purpose, appropriate formal relationship and register, and sufficiently developed, relevant coverage of every component in the three bullet points. Do not replace the requested function with a related but different one; at least 150 words.

criteria.label: Task response — Task 2
criteria.description: For Task 2 only: address both stated questions with clear, developed answers and relevant support. Explain possible causes of the photography focus and evaluate the development. Write at least 250 words.

criteria.label: Coherence and cohesion
criteria.description: Assess logical progression, purposeful paragraphs and clear referencing/linking within each response; avoid mechanical connector counts.

criteria.label: Lexical resource
criteria.description: Assess accurate, appropriate vocabulary and collocation, flexibility of expression and the effect of spelling or word-formation errors in each response.

criteria.label: Grammatical range and accuracy
criteria.description: Assess control of simple and complex structures, sentence boundaries and punctuation, with attention to errors that obscure meaning in each response.

assessment.feedbackGuidance: After submission only: Private annotated letter snippets: “Over the past two years, I have learned to coordinate orders across several teams.” supplies relevant learning instead of only naming a role. “In the planning department, I could use that experience to identify delays before they affect other teams.” links existing learning with a plausible organisational benefit. “I would like to continue here because the collaborative approach suits the way I work.” explains retention rather than treating a move as a resignation. Do not require these job details. Private essay snippet: “A photograph can become evidence of having visited a place, so the image may become the goal rather than a record of the experience.” develops a cause; evaluation of the development remains a separate requirement. Map all three bullet functions to actual learner spans and identify any missing component. Separate missing content from vague development or inappropriate register. Explain one useful paragraphing choice, one lexical choice and one grammar issue with evidence; ask the learner to revise an underdeveloped point and an unclear sentence, then explain the revisions. Do not require these exemplar details, memorised text, real contact details or a fixed greeting/closing formula beyond the task. No band, score, calibrated estimate or official examiner claim. Review q1 and q2 separately: Task achievement for the letter, Task response for the essay; Coherence and cohesion, Lexical resource and Grammatical range and accuracy apply separately to each. The essay must develop answers to both stated questions, with reasons and relevant examples. Do not convert the two practice responses into a combined Writing score.

locale.instructionsFa: به انگلیسی و در بندهای پیوسته بنویسید. همهٔ موارد نامه را پاسخ دهید و دست‌کم ۱۵۰ واژه بنویسید. مقالهٔ جداگانهٔ بخش دوم را با دست‌کم ۲۵۰ واژه کامل کنید.

teachingAnchorsFa.label: ابتدا زبان
teachingAnchorsFa.text: تجربهٔ به‌دست‌آمده را از کمک پیشنهادی آینده جدا کنید. I have learned با over two years تجربهٔ انباشته را می‌رساند؛ I could use this پیشنهاد است، نه تضمین. یک مهارت مشخص و کاربردش در بخش دیگر را توضیح دهید و نتیجهٔ بی‌پشتوانه وعده ندهید.

teachingAnchorsFa.label: طرح برای مخاطب
teachingAnchorsFa.text: سه بخش طرح را جدا کنید: یادگیری در نقش فعلی، سود جابه‌جایی برای سازمان، و دلیل ماندن. هر بخش توضیح می‌خواهد؛ اشتیاق به‌تنهایی سود سازمان را ثابت نمی‌کند. درخواست رسمی و محترمانه باشد و جابه‌جایی را با استعفا یکی نگیرید. دو سؤال مقاله را جدا طرح‌ریزی کنید.

teachingAnchorsFa.label: نوشتن و بازبینی
teachingAnchorsFa.text: نامه را کامل و در بندهای پیوسته بنویسید. هر جزء خواسته‌شده را به جمله‌ای مشخص وصل کنید. زمان‌ها و ضمیرها را بخوانید. یک دلیل کم‌توضیح و یک جملهٔ نادرست را اصلاح کنید. برای مقالهٔ جداگانه، هر یک از دو سؤال را مستقل طرح‌ریزی و پاسخ دهید؛ توضیح علت جای ارزیابی را نمی‌گیرد.

locale.feedbackGuidanceFa: پس از ثبت پاسخ، برای هر جزء خواسته‌شده یک شاهد از نوشته بیابید. نبود محتوا، توضیح ناکافی و لحن نامناسب را جدا بررسی کنید. یک دلیل را به پیامد مرتبط کنید و یک عبارت زمانی یا جمله را اصلاح کنید. بازخورد، نمره یا برآورد معتبر آیلتس نیست. نامه و مقاله جدا ارزیابی شوند؛ مقاله باید به هر دو سؤال پاسخ دهد.
